The Journey

The Girl Who Walked Into Engineering

"College is not just about the degree you leave with. It is about the person you become while earning it."

"Cheers to the journey of learning, unlearning, and re-learning!"

Four years ago, I walked into engineering as someone primarily focused on academics—believing that success was purely about grades, assignments, and exam results.

Somewhere along the journey, I started saying yes. I stepped out of my comfort zone into hackathons, technical conferences, and department stages. I took up leadership, serving as Vice President of my departmental club, coordinating IEEE Student Branch events, anchoring campus-wide events, and learning to lead with empathy and clarity.

On 15th May 2026, I officially completed my B.E. in Artificial Intelligence & Data Science from S.G Balekundri Institute of Technology (SGBIT). I walk forward not just with a degree, but with published research, real-world engineering prototypes, and an insatiable curiosity to keep learning.

Guiding Life Principle A humble mindset of continuous growth, lifelong curiosity, and resilient problem solving.

B.E. Graduation Milestone 🎓

Officially graduated in Artificial Intelligence & Data Science. Four years of growth, friendships, research breakthroughs, and technical leadership.

Published Research

An AI-Driven Framework for Digital Well-being

Addressing compulsive short-form content consumption through behavior-aware recommendations, adaptive UI/UX, and respectful behavioral nudges.

IRJMETS • Volume 07, Issue 12 • Ref: 71200186343

"An AI-Driven Framework for Mitigating Short-Form Content Addiction"

By Anshul Vinod Halakarni, Rutuja Chopade, and Rania Jamadar
Guided by Prof. Chandrashekara H. • Published: 04 Jan 2026

The rapid proliferation of short-form digital content platforms has led to compulsive scrolling, reduced attention spans, and diminished user well-being. Our project, VIBE, introduces a behavioral AI framework that passively evaluates session duration, scrolling velocity, and engagement frequency to deploy time-based interventions and dynamic feed moderation—fostering mindful, value-oriented digital consumption without sacrificing engagement.
